excerpt: Blog post: https://huggingface.co/blog/ggml-org/llama-cpp-v1 ## Overview llama.cpp v1.0.0 removes the deprecated public API and promotes the NextN/speculative API to `llama.h`, adds OCP FP8 KV caches, a host-memory MoE expert cache with a configurable CPU share, and loading of external PLE shards. It adds three text architectures (Kimi-K3.1-Pro, Ripple and xing4_0), drama-3 TTS, and MageVL-Cowork and Kimi-K3.1 vision, hardens `llama-server` (SSRF, CORS, DNS rebinding, MCP tool cancellation) and adds a `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint, ships a redesigned web UI with chat groups and a markdown editor, and updates `ggml` to v1.0.0. ### API changes - llama.h: remove `llama_set_warmup`, 35 deprecated functions, `defrag_thold` and `--defrag-thold` ([#30565](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30565)) - llama.h: promote the NextN API from `llama-ext.h` and rename `llama_set_embd_state_src` to `llama_set_ctx_state_src` ([#30565](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30565)) - llama.h: add `moe_cache_size` and `moe_cache_cpu_share
